title: BUG: RSA verify uses fixed 512-byte stack buffer, silent overflow for RSA-4096
description: soft_verify() in wp11_backend_soft.c calls wc_RsaSSL_Verify() with a 512-byte output buffer. RSA-4096 decrypts to a 512-byte block exactly, but the buffer size matches only if the key is exactly 4096 bits. A crafted or mismatched key could write past the buffer. Also wc_RsaSSL_Verify writes to an internal buffer and returns a pointer; the 512-byte out[] is passed as the output but the wolfCrypt API may or may not use it directly. Research the exact wc_RsaSSL_Verify API contract, then fix if it can overflow.
